name: Composite Loss
definition: A distortion loss formulation that combines multiple perceptual and pixel-level metrics to better align with human visual perception than standard L1/SSIM losses.
summary: Composite Loss is a distortion metric for 3D Gaussian Splatting that combines L1, L2, MS-SSIM, and LPIPS errors to better align rendered images with human visual perception than standard single-metric losses.
